name: notex
description: Find and read NoteX notes, then draft source-grounded work in ChatGPT or Codex.

interface.longDescription: Find notes by title, read selected summaries and transcripts, and draft meeting briefs, follow-ups, action items, and specifications grounded in those sources. Drafts stay in your ChatGPT or Codex conversation; this plugin does not write to NoteX or send messages. Search is title-only. The local demo uses your own NoteX API key provisioned outside the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Find the NoteX note I choose and prepare a sourced meeting brief.
Draft follow-up and action items from a NoteX note I choose.
Turn a NoteX note I choose into a sourced specification draft.
